verdict.rationale: CMS IndusLaw is an India-based law firm offering legal advisory services, not a software or data-hosting product, so letting a user choose a storage region is a category error for this kind of offering. Its Data Protection & Privacy practice advises clients on compliance (DPDP Act, GDPR), but that is legal advice about data governance, not a product capability for selecting data residency.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
